title: PV-P75 / PV-P100-110 control specification (calculated / simulated, NOT bench-validated)
hardware_basis: cost-first build as drawn: PV-PWR (3 phases) / PV-PWR-4 (4 phases) rev A2, PV-CTL rev A1 (F280039C), inductor rev M2, sensor STK-HO/A 75; the CTRL-C2000 / PVCELL-25 / PV-PORT values of the earlier platform are no longer used

loop_structure.inner: per cell: average inductor-current PI (64 kHz, double update), port-voltage feed-forward inside the modulator, dead-time feed-forward from the current REFERENCE with the midpoint dead-time estimate (dead_time section), clamping anti-windup
loop_structure.modulator: buck / band / boost exactly as cell_spec switching.modes; controller output = average inductor voltage, so the loop gain does not change between modes
loop_structure.outer: 32 kHz, one per module: V_A loop (MPPT reference or DC bus on A) or V_B loop (DC bus forming on B), port-B over-voltage limit loop, each with gains scaled to its own port bank; per-cell limits (limits section): inductor current by mode, node-A power 27.5 kW, both port currents; candidates min-selected with tracking anti-windup; port-current reference -> per-cell inductor-current reference through the cells' ACTUAL duty (carries the mode hysteresis); each cell's limits use its own duty and mode and are slew-limited (ilim_slew_A_per_s)
loop_structure.mppt: dP-P&O at 20 Hz on oversampled V_A, I_A (sim/pv_mppt.py) -> V_A reference, ramp-limited
loop_structure.sharing: equal per-cell references (I_port* / (N_active D)), each cell closes its own current loop

feed_forward.basis: with a stiff source (battery) the port-current feed-forward closes a unity loop; on a PV port it cancels the array's own damping

sampling.carrier: centre-aligned up-down, double update (zero and period)
sampling.i_L_sample: each cell at its own carrier zero and peak + 0.81 us (compensates the drawn sensor + AFE delay)
sampling.computation_delay: one sample (duty computed from the sample at t_k is loaded at t_k + Ts) - REQUIRED: with two samples the current loop keeps only 43.9 deg (stability/computation_delay)
sampling.controller: F280039C, 120 MHz C28x + 120 MHz CLA (architecture: ~200 cycles per current-loop execution = 1.7 us, 6 / 8 per 31.25 us; R-14 open until the firmware is timed)
sampling.port_V_conversion_note: the PPB backup evaluates every V_A / V_B conversion; PV-CTL converts them every 10 us

current_loop.form: q += ki Ts e; u = kp e + q (volts across L)
current_loop.anti_windup: integrator clamped to the realisable inductor voltage
current_loop.reduced_model_basis: 1/(sL + R), exact ZOH, PI, chain lag uncompensated, ideal ports (review PCM-02 cross-check; report section 5)

outer_loops.kpv_kiv_scale: per port with that port's bank as drawn: N=3 A 289.8 uF / B 334.8 uF; N=4 386.4 / 386.4 uF

i_phase_max_A.basis: inductor mean current, by the cell's own modulation mode. Buck / boost (one leg switching, ripple up to 34.6 A pp): the inductor's DC design current (cell_spec inductor I_dc_max; normal peak 62.3 A, 1.10 x = 68.5 A against the 67.9 A window edge: short by 0.6 A - the window's own design-margin item (PV-CTL), the window stays above the normal peak). Band (both legs near D_max, ripple 9.3 A pp at most): the inductor's rms design value I_rms_max, the band point the power stage, devices and module thermal model were sized at (P_lim at unity ratio); normal peak 52.3 A over the band as occupied (report 12.2). Not raised beyond the hardware's design point

limits.port_limits_basis: lean ports (module_spec): PV port (A) = the module rating I_port_max, no fuse; battery port (B) = cost-first battery_port_limit_A (the aR fuse pair, D-056) - 135 A on PV-P75, 145 A on PV-P100/110; flat in inlet temperature. Enforced per cell as port limit / (N x actual duty) with a slow trim on the measured port current
limits.thermal_derating_basis: module_spec cost-first derating_thermal_only_fraction (sim/pv_module.py, on the delivered power); firmware derates on the NTC readings (PV-CTL), the envelope applies the fraction

envelope.policy: this script's control law: inductor current 45.0 A (buck / boost) / 47.70 A (band), node-A power 27.5 kW per cell (node A = the PV / source side for A->B, the sink for B->A; the phase limit is a node-A power too), lean port currents, module_spec thermal derating on the delivered power; delivered = source power x the module efficiency of sim/pv_module.py (module_envelope.csv at P_lim, 25 C, corrected to the inlet with module_spec's 25 -> 45 C corner drop; same for both directions)

rows.binding_35C: phase current = port A current = thermal
rows.binding_45C: phase current = port A current = thermal

rows.binding_35C: phase current = port A current = thermal
rows.binding_45C: phase current = port A current = thermal

rows.binding_35C: phase current = node-A power = port A current
rows.binding_45C: phase current = node-A power = port A current

rows.binding_35C: phase current = port A current = thermal
phase current = port A current = thermal
phase current = port A current = thermal
phase current = port A current = thermal

envelope.note: 75 kW at exactly 550/550 V needs 136.4 A at the port before loss: PV-04/PV-07 (full load from 550 V) and PV-05/PV-08 (135 A) are inconsistent by 1.0 % at that corner; 74.25 kW is the most the 135 A port passes there before loss

modulator.D_max_basis: 1 - t_min f_sw, the same in every mode; t_min 1.771 us = 0.6 us complementary on-time + 2 x the 586 ns longest dead time at the gates (cell_spec min_pulse_basis); the i_L sample's S/H window closes 0.5 ns before the edge of a minimum pulse centred on the sampling extremum (report 12.1)
modulator.enter_band: single-leg duty (with that mode's dead-time term) > D_max
modulator.band_rule: lower-voltage-side leg at D_max, the other leg carries the control; when the demand exceeds that leg, the roles swap continuously (v_B* = min(D_max V_B, D_max V_A - u))

dead_time.compensation: per switching leg, the voltage lost in the edge whose current flows against the commanded transition (A->B: leg A rising, leg B falling; B->A: leg A falling, leg B rising) = t_hat x f_sw x V_leg, applied as feed-forward in the modulator; the edge-current sign comes from a model of the closed current loop (the current REFERENCE slew-limited to 0.8 A/us) plus the predicted ripple, with a 2 A ramp; the PI integrator takes the residual
dead_time.mode_logic: each candidate mode judged with its own dead-time terms; enter band at once when the single-leg duty exceeds D_max; leave band only below D_max - 0.02 for both the demand u and the PI integrator filtered with 3 ms
firmware_must: use the midpoint of the hardware dead-time range as the estimate for every edge (no per-unit value is needed)
drive the dead-time compensation from the slew-limited current reference (closed-loop model), not from the measured current
keep the band-exit hysteresis >= 0.02 in duty and test the exit also on the PI integrator filtered with 3 ms
derive each cell's limits from its own duty and mode and slew them (no ratio map)
convert port current references with the cells' actual duty
optional: identify each edge's dead time (integrator jump at the first band entry / exit) - it cuts the worst transition error from 3.26 A to 1.98 A; not needed for stability or limits

accuracy_after_cal.basis: the drawn sensor after the 2-point calibration (PV-PWR design check), as used by the sharing study (result: sharing/)

cell_inductor_current.basis: CMPSS backup (upper band 101.9 A) must have the gates off within 3.48 us (fastest bank-short rise to L = 50 % L0) = delay current -> CMPSS input <= 3.08 us + comparator, filter, trip zone and driver 0.40 us (PV-CTL); as drawn 0.81 us, peak 111 A. Current-loop phase: sampled 0.81 us after the carrier extremum; sharing within 2.2 % of 45 A

port_voltage_VA_VB.accuracy: PV-CTL design check 'ADC accuracy' (after the 2-point calibration, incl. the PV-PWR divider)
port_voltage_VA_VB.basis: the comparator at its upper band edge 1110 V keeps the gates-off voltage <= 1135 V if its whole lag (divider pole + overdrive + comparator + logic) is <= 111 us at 82.5 kW (69 us in the frozen-current case); as drawn 47 us. Range: up to the device-rule voltage, the highest port voltage the trips and the over-voltage analysis read

port_current_IA_IB.basis: load-current feed-forward on a bus port (the CPL margin at 250 V rests on it: without it see stability/N3/cpl_without_feedforward_*); as drawn: lean shunt 11.3 kHz pole (PV-PWR); MPPT power measurement (oversampling requirement in sim/pv_mppt.py)

hardware_trips.architecture: as drawn: PV-CTL rev A1 trip table (local IL window from each sensor's reference, CMPSS backup, VA / VB comparator, ADC PPB backup) and PV-PWR rev A2 (port OC comparators on FLT_N, gate-drive DESAT); one latch gates every PWM, EN and contactor command (PV-CTL design check)

inductor_overcurrent.type: two layers: PV-CTL local window +74.2 / -74.2 A (67.9-80.5 A) -> latch, 1.52 us to gates off; CMPSS window on IL +/-91.5 A (81.1-101.9 A), 1.21 us, as backup
inductor_overcurrent.basis: time for the fastest bank-short current to rise from the layer's upper band edge to L = 50 % L0 (129 A); device pulse rating 376 A per position

ctrl_backup.note: PV-CTL CMPSS1-4 window on the IL ADC pins (key name kept from the earlier card)

inductor_overcurrent.sensor_as_built: STK-HO/A 75 on PV-PWR + PV-CTL AFE: 10.14 mV/A at the ADC, 0.0722 A/count, -3 dB 331 kHz, delay 0.81 us, noise 2.3 A pp

port_overvoltage.type: primary: PV-CTL comparator on VA / VB 1074 V (1039-1110 V), lag 47 us; backup: ADC PPB 1100 V (1084-1116 V), converted every 10 us, lag 33.9 us; both behind the PV-PWR divider pole (6.8 kHz)
port_overvoltage.basis: port voltage at the last switching event <= 1135 V (0.85 V_DSS incl. 301 V ringing scaled with V); film bank 1.15 x 1100 V = 1265 V not binding; slope 0.22 V/us at 82.5 kW with port B 334.8 uF

full_current_frozen_case.case: outer control frozen, cells held at their limit, stiff port A at 1000 V, port B (611 V) opens

desat.withstand_basis: no Chinese datasheet states one; MSC035SMA170B4 3.1 us typ (1200 V, 20 V), ROHM SCT4036KRHR 4 us - ASSUMPTION to be confirmed by the makers or a SC test
desat.source: PV-PWR gate drive (gdrv lean channel): threshold and blanking as drawn; booster detection-to-off from cell_spec / gen/gdrv.py

port_overcurrent_A.source: PV-PWR comparators on the IH shunt path -> FLT_N (no firmware); backup CMPSS4 / ADC PPB on IA / IB (PV-CTL); no separate short-circuit level

terminal_short_reverse_conduction.reverse_clamp: none on PV-PWR (D-044 gave up terminal-short survival)
terminal_short_reverse_conduction.note: static model at the lumped port node (5 mOhm / 1 uH bolted short); the architecture accepts that the port-side legs are likely destroyed (ARCHITECTURE-COSTFIRST 6.4)

min_PM_current_loop: cur (current loop, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 250 V, full load, band
min_GM_current_loop_dB: cvb_cpl (CP source on B, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 250 V, full load, band
min_PM_outer: cva_cpl (CPL on A, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 250 V, full load, band
min_modulus_margin_outer: cva_cpl (CPL on A, B->A), V_A 550 V / V_B 250 V, full load, buck
min_gain_margin_outer_dB: cva_cpl (CPL on A, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 250 V, full load, band

min_PM_current_loop: cur (current loop, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 550 V, full load, boost
min_GM_current_loop_dB: cvb_bat (battery on B (CV), A->B), V_A 250 V / V_B 550 V, full load, boost
min_PM_outer: cva_cpl (CPL on A, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 550 V, full load, boost
min_modulus_margin_outer: cvb_cpl (CPL on B, A->B), V_A 250 V / V_B 550 V, full load, boost
min_gain_margin_outer_dB: cva_cpl (CPL on A, B->A), V_A 250 V / V_B 550 V, full load, boost

mppt.algorithm: dP-P&O (Sera 2008) with elasticity-adaptive step + scheduled global scan

measurement.basis: with the 32 kHz control samples only the static efficiency falls to 99.83 % at 50 W/m2

control_board.peripheral and setting: CMPSS1-4 H+L on the pin plan's mux index, DAC from VDAC (= VREF); CTRIPH|CTRIPL -> ePWM X-BAR TRIP4 -> DCAEVT1 -> one-shot on all ePWM
control_board.start-up self-test: idle: DACH below / DACL above the zero -> OST flag must set; restore

control_board.peripheral and setting: ADC PPB on IA (ADC-A), IB (ADC-C), converted at carrier zero and peak, offset = idle zero; PV-P75: CMPSS4 window on IB -> TRIP5 -> one-shot
control_board.start-up self-test: PPB limit inside the idle reading -> ADCEVT -> OST flag; restore

control_board.peripheral and setting: ADC PPB on VA (ADC-A), VB (ADC-B), every <= 10 us -> TRIP5 -> one-shot
ADC, controlled stop (no latch)
ADC NTC1-8 + inlet: derating, controlled stop below the hardware band
control_board.threshold / band: heatsink <= 85 C (hw 86.2-89.6 C), inductor <= 145 C (hw 146.1-153.9 C)
control_board.start-up self-test: cold start: every NTC within 10 K of the inlet NTC; open / short flagged (hw trips anyway)

control_board.peripheral and setting: GPIO inputs (X-BAR -> XINT), read and logged before any clear. Trip cause: FLT_N, RDY or STOP_OK low -> that source; PRE_N low with those high and the heartbeat running -> an on-board comparator (IL window, port OV, NTC OT / open probe), which one from the ADC and the recorder (rev A2: OC_N / OVT_N are not read); DI1 = battery fault / BMS contact (NO / NC set by parameter) -> controlled stop, K_B open after the current is low
control_board.start-up self-test: BIAS_EN low -> RDY low (latch sets); BIAS_EN high -> RDY high

control_board.peripheral and setting: GPIO27 toggled in the control ISR (period <= 2 ms)
control_board.start-up self-test: stop toggling 10 ms -> TRIP must set; then clear

control_board.peripheral and setting: GPIO24 rising edge only with every source inactive, OST flags cleared, PWM commands low, cause in the recorder flash; no automatic clear after a watchdog reset, OC or OV trip
control_board.start-up self-test: power-up: TRIP = 1 must be read before the first clear

control_board.peripheral and setting: ePWM dead-band generator (the drivers' cross-wired inputs still block an overlap)
WD on from boot, serviced from the background loop only after the ISR ran; NMI watchdog on
missing-clock detect (PLL limp) + DCC on X1 vs INTOSC2 -> NMI: force OST on all ePWM, stop the heartbeat; unhandled -> NMI-watchdog reset
keep the I/O BOR enabled (2.81-3.0 V); TPS3828 2.88-3.00 V -> XRSn: IOs Hi-Z, latch set
WDRS / NMIWDRS drive XRSn: IOs Hi-Z, monoflop cleared, latch set; reboot reads the reset cause, logs it, stays tripped until commanded
after init: lock GPIO mux / direction and the X-BAR selections where the device offers a lock; command pins without pull-up; CMPSS, PPB, TZ, dead band read back every 10 ms -> trip on mismatch
phase 4 idle: ePWM7/8 held by a forced one-shot, IL4 / NTC4 / NTC8 ignored, CMPSS4 on IB; the phase-4 TLV9024 pair is not fitted (assembly option)
control_board.start-up self-test: build code from the recorder flash

control_board.item: Ethernet (EMS, Modbus TCP; fitted on the PCS variants)
control_board.peripheral and setting: SCIB 115200 8-N-1 (LSPCLK 60 MHz) to the CH9121T in TCP SERVER mode, port 502: the bridge forwards the TCP payload byte for byte, so the Modbus server parses Modbus TCP (MBAP + PDU), or RTU framing when the EMS uses RTU over TCP; one register map for RS-485 and Ethernet (firmware hand-over); IP / port written by the MCU through the CH9121 serial configuration (CFG test point pulled low once at end of line to enable the serial handshake); the TSSOP-20 cannot disable the maker's LAN set-up tool (no CFGEN pin): every write to the module is authorised in firmware; clients per port not stated by WCH (ASSUMED one)
control_board.start-up self-test: end of line: link, loop-back through the EMS port

control_board.peripheral and setting: 32 channels in a RAM ring at the decimated rate (100 ms) + a 2 ms full-rate snapshot; trigger = TRIP or a firmware fault; 100 ms after the trigger; written into the next pre-erased slot of the flash ring with time stamp and cause; calibration, serial number and event log in two copies with CRC (R-WS-9)
control_board.start-up self-test: read-back of the last record header at start

control_board.peripheral and setting: authenticated dual image: the new image is staged in the recorder flash over Ethernet, RS-485 or CAN, signature + CRC checked, copied by a bootloader in a DCSM-protected sector; the golden image stays for roll-back; only in SERVICE with authorisation and timeout (R-WS-8)

module address by software over the module CAN (no DIP); port roles as the design check (module bus = CAN, BMS = RS-485 or CAN, EMS = Ethernet or RS-485, PC tool 9600-8-N-1 on RS-485); relay = STATUS_M (healthy) through the latch gating

control_board.item: firmware practice adopted from the Wolfspeed firmware cross-check (docs/requirements/REFERENCE-LESSONS.md section 6, R-WS-1..9)
control_board.peripheral and setting: range-checked bus/service inputs (switching frequency and dead time not writable in operation); ramp to zero and stop on communication loss (ASSUMED 1 s on CAN); lock-out after the third hazard trip of a class within 10 min (ASSUMED) and at once when hardware and firmware both see an over-voltage; explicit recovery threshold, dwell and restart-rate limit per non-latched limit; every exception path forces the one-shot trip and stops the heartbeat, clock-fail and emulation-stop trips enabled; no bus-reachable mode disables a protection, parameter writes only in SERVICE with authorisation and timeout
control_board.start-up self-test: self-test fires each fault line alone; the 10 ms read-back covers the trip routing; calibration stored redundantly and range-checked, a failed load blocks the start

control_board.peripheral and setting: FAN_PWM from the inlet NTC (NTC_IN): inlet NTC < fan rating (-10 C) at start-up: fans OFF, module power <= the table row of the inlet reading (table kW, nominal), no other change to the control; fans enabled (speed from the fan law) once the inlet NTC reads above the fan rating; fans start at once at any heatsink NTC above the start level or inductor NTC above its start level, whatever the inlet reads (backstop for the passive estimate)
control_board.threshold / band: inlet -10 C (fan rating); passive power PV-P75 19.2 / 17.5 / 15.5 kW at -30 / -20 / -10 C inlet; PV-P100/110 19.9 / 14.9 / 4.9 kW at -30 / -20 / -10 C inlet (ESTIMATE +-50 %, module_spec.json); start regardless of the inlet: heatsink NTC 80 C, inductor NTC 135 C

rules: close K_A / K_B only while the terminal-side divider reads >= the polarity enable (both ports)
close K_B only after precharge with |V_bank - V_term| <= the dV enable; open K_PRE afterwards
port OC trip from the ADC limit on IA / IB (IM path) -> trip latch -> contactor off, within the latency (second layer behind the hardware OC window)
the hold-off comparator stays in hardware: above 0.97-1.03 kA a closed contactor is held regardless
ports.basis: D-050: firmware duplicates the hardware interlocks and OC trip; bands = the hardware comparators' worst-case windows; latency from the HPE501 250 A melting curve (to 0.95 kA, and to the hold-band top)

system.item: DC-bus coordination with PCS-P125 on a battery-less bus (system rule, review R2-04; bus forming on port B)
system.peripheral and setting: outer loop (32 kHz): V_B (the period's 16-sample mean, PV-PWR divider 6.8 kHz) > V_B* + 30 V at one sample -> every cell's current reference to 0 at once (PWM running; the V_B-max candidate wins the min-select, integrators reset); released below V_B* + 15 V, the V_B loop resumes from the measured current. Local by necessity: a module-CAN message is too slow (0.54 ms for one frame behind one already on the bus at 500 kbit/s, ASSUMED, before detection and task latency)
system.threshold / band: V_B* + 30 V (ASSUMED: above this module's own +23.9 V bus-forming overshoot at a full CPL drop, section 9.1); cut complete within 0.51 ms of the rejection at the PCS study's 750 V bus and 125 kW (pcs_control_spec vf_bounded); this chain 209 us = 75 us to the threshold (source current alone into the PCS link) + 23 us divider lag + 47 us sampling + 64 us current decay (1/(2 pi 2500 Hz), charge-equivalent) = x2.42 margin (x2 ASSUMED); the budget shrinks as V_B* nears the PCS's 975 V soft limit: x2 holds to V_B* = 782 V, above it a shared hardwired trip line or a battery; this module's own 335 uF port-B bank on the same bus not credited (it lengthens the budget more than the crossing)
system.consequence: otherwise the PCS trips on DC over-voltage 1.50-1.94 ms after the rejection and the bus is left at 1060-1061 V, latched
system.source: sim/out/pcs_control/pcs_control_spec.json (vf_bounded, dc_rejection_bounded, inputs) + this study's V_B chain

honesty: Simulation only. Power stage ideal-switch, sensors first-order, PV/battery/CPL models are assumptions listed in report.md; nothing is bench-validated.
